summary.zh: 访问项目、议题与合并请求
summary.en: Access projects, issues, and merge requests

description.zh: 读取 GitLab.com 上的项目、文件、议题与合并请求，支持搜索与差异查看。适合跟进研发进度或核对某次改动。首次连接跳转 GitLab 登录页完成授权。
description.en: Read projects, files, issues, and merge requests on GitLab.com, including search and diff views. Good for following development progress or checking a specific change. GitLab sign-in and consent happen in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 GitLab 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to GitLab and authorize on first connect
